Source.Name: zerotier-one
Source.Description:
ZeroTier One creates secure, peer-to-peer virtual networks that behave like a single Ethernet switch, connecting devices anywhere over the internet. This package builds only the MPL-2.0 licensed client; the source-available network controller is not included.
To run ZeroTier as a system service, enable it with: sudo systemctl enable --now zerotier-one Alternatively, run the daemon manually with: sudo zerotier-one -d
